page.content:
One-eyed Allfather, seeker of runes, lord of the slain.

How Odin connects

  • Faction: Aesir — Odin is chief of the Aesir.
  • Location: Valhalla — Odin hosts the einherjar in Valhalla.
  • Character: Loki — Loki is Odin's blood-brother and the Aesir's most dangerous guest.
  • Event: Ragnarok — Odin falls to Fenrir in the last battle.

What is Odin?

Odin hung on Yggdrasil for the runes, gave an eye at Mimir's well, and gathers the einherjar. He is a god of poetry, kingship, and a doomed wisdom that sees Ragnarok coming.

Key threads lead to Aesir, Valhalla, Loki and Ragnarok.
